purpose: Analyze student drop-out data across two batches to identify trends, common reasons for withdrawal, and academic performance metrics.
audience: Academic administrators and student affairs officers
kpis: Total number of students who dropped out
Average GPA of dropping out students

charts.title: Student Drop-out Distribution by Batch
charts.description: Compare the number of drop-outs between Batch 1 and Batch 2.

charts.title: Reasons for Withdrawal Pie Chart
charts.description: Show the proportion of students dropping out due to each reason.
fields: สาเหตุการลาออก

charts.title: Average GPA by Faculty
charts.description: Display the average GPA of students who dropped out in each faculty.

charts.title: Student Drop-out Timeline
charts.description: Show the trend of drop-outs over time.
fields: วันที่ลาออก

insight_questions: What are the most common reasons for student withdrawal in each batch?
How does the average GPA of dropping out students compare across different faculties?
Are there any seasonal trends in student drop-outs?
last_instruction: I would like this dashboard to display the total number of students; a breakdown of students by faculty/major (shown as a pie chart); a year-by-year comparison of student numbers; the number of student withdrawals (categorized by month, year, and faculty/major); a breakdown of reasons for withdrawal; the graduation rate based on a four-year cycle (with student year levels calculated from the first two digits of the student ID—e.g., "66" indicates the intake year); and the ratio of students who graduated versus those who did not.
